preconditions.expression: all(c in {'?', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in S)
preconditions.description: Every character in string S is either '?' or one of {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in A)
preconditions.description: Every character in string A is one of {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.
The lengths of S and A are exactly N and M, respectively.
The lengths N and M are non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in S_prime)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output string S' is one of {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

postconditions.expression: (S_prime == '-1') or (len(S_prime) == N and all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in S_prime))
postconditions.description: If S' is not '-1', its length is N and all characters are valid.
If S' is not '-1', A is not a subsequence of S'.

postconditions.expression: (S_prime != '-1') or (all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in S_prime))
postconditions.description: If S' is '-1', it indicates no valid S' exists where A is not a subsequence.
